vintage: GUNB permit register, file of 2026-11-27; decisions 2016-01 to 2026-10
rules: Each marker is one building permit decision for a new industrial or storage building (category XVIII of the building law: factories, plants, warehouses, cold stores), shown in the gmina and the month of the decision.
A decision is counted once per gmina by its issuing authority and decision number; a decision for buildings in two gminas counts in each.
The register holds first-instance decisions entered since 2016-01, without closed (military) areas; it does not say whether the building was built.
Each gmina is drawn at the centre of its area.
notes: 1701 decisions without a usable TERC code and 0 rows without a decision date are left out.
0 gminas have no outline or hex to stand on and are left out.
The file of 2026-11-27 covers 2026-10 in full; later decisions wait for the next file.
